items.text: In the left main menu, click "Open Meeting" to open the meeting.
On the Meeting List page, find today's meeting.
Open the pre-meeting summary.
In the bottom-right corner of the page, click "Export Notes" to save the summary as notes.
In the left main menu, click "Open Meeting" to open the meeting.
On the Meeting List page, find today's meeting.
In the toolbar at the top right of the meeting detail page, click the "Meeting Summary" button.
In the bottom-right corner of the page, click "Export Notes" to save the summary as notes.
In the left main menu, click "Open Meeting" to open the meeting.
At the top right of the meeting detail page, click "Share Link" to create a share link.
In the share panel, click "Share Summary" and pick the key-point sections to share.
In the bottom-right corner of the page, click "Export Notes" to save the summary as notes.
In the avatar menu at the top right, click "Settings Page" to open your settings.
In the left column of the settings page, click "Notification Settings".
In the Notification Channel field, enter the mailbox or channel that should receive reminders.
In the bottom-right corner of the page, click "Export Notes" to save a summary of your settings as notes.
In the left main menu, click "Open Meeting" to open the meeting.
On the Meeting List page, switch the time range to "This week".
Read the Weekly Digest section.
In the bottom-right corner of the page, click "Export Notes" to save the summary as notes.
In the left main menu, click "Open Meeting" to open the meeting.
On the Meeting List page, switch the time range to "This week".
Read the Weekly Digest section. It lists the highlights of every meeting this week.
In the bottom-right corner of the page, click "Export Notes" to save the summary as notes.
In the left main menu, click "Open Meeting" to open the meeting.
On the Meeting List page, switch the time range to "This week".
Read the Weekly Digest section. It lists the highlights of every meeting this week, newest first.
In the bottom-right corner of the page, click "Export Notes" to save the summary as notes.
In the left main menu, click "Open Meeting" to open the meeting.
On the Meeting List page, switch the time range to "This week".
Read the Weekly Digest section. Any section that was skipped can be expanded under "More highlights" on the same page.
In the bottom-right corner of the page, click "Export Notes" to save the summary as notes.
